subject: Post-demo: BrightCart pilot — token economics & credit pathway
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Emma Barnes <emma@brightcart.com>, Theo Lin <theo@brightcart.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: BrightCart pilot — token economics & credit pathway
Attachments: redwood_pilot_estimate.pdf (pdf)

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to meet the BrightCart team. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can size a pilot that fits your budget and gives you meaningful signals.

Summary of what we heard on the demo:
- Main use: real-time product Q&A (chat) + periodic catalog embedding refreshes for similarity search.
- Expected peak QPS: small (10–20), but steady conversational traffic.
- Desired pilot length: 4–6 weeks to exercise scale and quality.

To finalize the pilot plan I need two quick pieces of input from you:
1) Rough monthly token volumes (generation + embedding tokens). Example buckets are "Low: ~5M/mo", "Mid: 10–20M/mo", "High: 50M+" — which band looks right?
2) Budget range you can commit to for the pilot (monthly or total for the pilot). This helps me propose an appropriate credit and the right model/quantization tradeoffs.

Attached is a baseline estimate (redwood_pilot_estimate.pdf) showing per-1M token unit math for a couple of model variants and an example 6-week burn profile. Two important notes:
- Target $/1M tokens depends heavily on mix (chat tokens are more expensive than embeddings) and whether we enable KV prefix caching.
- We typically propose a target unit economic window (e.g., $800–$1,200 / 1M tokens) for early pilots and tune from there.

If you can share the token band and a pilot budget range by EOD Wed I’ll:
- Propose a credit top-up that gets you to the end of the pilot without mid-pilot interruptions,
- Lock in a recommended model + batch/caching config, and
- Schedule a 30-min kickoff with our solutions engineer to wire telemetry and success metrics.

Proposed next steps:
- You: reply with token band + budget range
- Me: return a concrete credit offer and pilot SLA / checkpoints

Thanks — looking forward.

Camila Reyes
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

-----Original estimate attached: redwood_pilot_estimate.pdf (see per-1M math, 6-week burn scenarios)
From: Emma Barnes <emma@brightcart.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: Theo Lin <theo@brightcart.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:29:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: BrightCart pilot — token economics & credit pathway

Camila — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers from our side below.

Token estimate (initial pilot):
- Chat (customer-facing product Q&A): ~12M generation tokens/month
- Embeddings (catalog reindex + similarity): ~3M embedding tokens/month
- Total ~15M tokens/month (we expect ramp during pilot from ~2M/week to ~4M/week)

Budget: we can commit to roughly $8k–$12k / month for the pilot period. The broader team is conservative; procurement will need a line item and a PO if we go beyond $15k total.

Request: would you be able to stretch free credits to ensure we don't hit a hard stop mid-pilot? An extra 4 weeks of runway would be ideal if the initial 6-week test is promising.

Also: procurement will want a short statement of work / pilot scope and a billing contact. I can loop them once you confirm numbers.

Emma Barnes
Head of Platform, BrightCart
emma@brightcart.com
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Emma Barnes <emma@brightcart.com>, Theo Lin <theo@brightcart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: BrightCart pilot — token economics & credit pathway
Attachments: credit_agreement-draft.pdf

Emma — perfect, that token mix is exactly what the estimate doc was modeled for. Based on ~15M tokens/mo (12M gen + 3M embed) and the budget window you provided, here's a concrete proposal: 

Offer (conditional):
- One-time pilot credit: $12,000 applied to the pilot account to cover the first 6 weeks of burn and give a buffer for initial ramp.
- Pilot runway: we can approve an optional 4-week extension credit (up to $8,000 additional) pending checkpoint review at week 4 (model quality + instrumentation).
- Target unit economics guidance: start with a served $/1M tokens target range of $900–$1,100 for the initial config (this factors chat+embed mix and moderate batching). If you enable aggressive KV prefix caching and accept a quantized serving profile we can push toward the lower end.

Conditions & success metrics (what we need to see to release extension credit):
- Week-by-week burn reporting (simple CSV or shared sheet) with token counts and approximate latency percentiles.
- Two checkpoints: week 2 (sanity check) and week 4 (decision point for extension).
- Basic instrumentation: we need your team to enable the telemetry SDK so we can correlate tokens to user journeys.

Next steps (if you accept):
1) Reply to confirm you want the $12k credit and that procurement can accept a draft credit agreement (attached).
2) I’ll loop Aditya for invoicing and Marissa for final approval.
3) Book a 30-min kickoff with our SE; I’ll send a calendar invite after confirmation.

Ben/Marissa — tagging you for awareness; this is within our typical pilot credit guardrails but procurement will want to see the SOW. If you can confirm the one-time $12k + conditional $8k extension that would unblock BrightCart quickly (deal: BRG-4521).

Camila Reyes
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

-----Attachment: credit_agreement-draft.pdf (redwood one-off pilot credit template)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: BrightCart pilot — token economics & credit pathway

Camila — approved. One-time $12,000 pilot credit is fine under BRG-4521. Conditional extension (up to $8k) OK pending the week-4 checkpoint and the telemetry requirement.

Notes for billing/invoicing (Aditya):
- Please prepare the credit application for BrightCart account and attach the signed credit agreement once returned.
- Billing contact on record will be procurement@brightcart.com; PO required for any additional paid invoices beyond the credit.

Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
